insights.title: IFS Secures LCC and Regional Carrier Wins
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFB footprint by securing MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), classified as an LCC, alongside fastjet and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC and fastjet as an African LCC, while TUS Airways is classified as hybrid/leisure/uncertain.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility represents limited public announcements rather than total market share.

insights.title: Thales and Aviobook Sign Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a network carrier connecting Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
insights.caveat: Single contract announcement captured during the period.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands Dispatch and EFFCore Deployments
insights.finding: Jeppesen secured major flight planning agreements with Korean Air and established Corendon Airlines as a launch customer for Dispatch v2026-2.
insights.aviation_context: Korean Air operates an integrated widebody and narrowbody fleet exceeding 240 aircraft.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect vendor press releases and official updates.

insights.title: TransNusa Adopts Navblue Skywise Solutions
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue to implement Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and low-cost services in Southeast Asia.
insights.caveat: Specific product implementation terms are limited to press summaries.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Updates Lido mPilot
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems released Lido mPilot 7.3 to incorporate aircraft-specific taxiway restrictions on Airport Moving Maps.
insights.aviation_context: Lido mPilot is an iOS-based EFB application utilized by commercial flight crews for digital navigation charts.
insights.caveat: Feature details are derived from vendor LinkedIn announcements.
